basic.description:
{Basic Eagle Eye}

Before the first turn of every battle, your hero fires a free Magic Arrow at every enemy stack (10 x Spell Power + 10 damage). Your hero also has a 100% chance to learn any spell of level 1-2 used in combat by the enemy, if your hero wins the battle.
